pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)
pronunciation_overrides.time-to-live: tˈIm tə lˈIv (misaki read 'live' as the verb /lɪv/)

lines.text: It works on your friend's phone, but not on yours. Why?
Phones get a site's address from a DNS resolver, which caches it.
The site moved servers. Your resolver keeps the old address until its [time-to-live](/tˈIm tə lˈIv/) runs out.
Your friend's resolver asked after the move and got the new one.
Compare both phones' addresses. Old one on yours? Stale cache. Same? Look [elsewhere](/ˈɛlswˌɛɹ/).
Moving a site? Lower the TTL first.
